dbPing.description: Connectivity check: returns a single row with ok = 1

getTripQuotes.description: Read the quotes of a trip (id, product, status, expires)
getTripQuotes.sql: SELECT Id AS id, Product AS product, Status AS status, Expires AS expires FROM Quotes WHERE TripId = @tripId

expireTripQuotes.description: Set the expiry of every quote of a trip to now + N minutes
expireTripQuotes.sql: UPDATE Quotes SET Expires = DATEADD(MINUTE, @minutes, GETDATE()) WHERE TripId = @tripId
expireTripQuotes.snapshot: SELECT Id AS id, Expires AS expires FROM Quotes WHERE TripId = @tripId

restoreQuoteExpires.description: Restore one quote's expiry by id
restoreQuoteExpires.sql: UPDATE Quotes SET Expires = @expires WHERE Id = @id

expireTripEvolviPricings.description: Set the expiry of every Evolvi pricing of a trip to now + N minutes
expireTripEvolviPricings.sql: UPDATE EvolviPricings SET Expires = DATEADD(MINUTE, @minutes, GETDATE()) WHERE QuoteId IN (SELECT Id FROM Quotes WHERE TripId = @tripId)
expireTripEvolviPricings.snapshot: SELECT Id AS id, Expires AS expires FROM EvolviPricings WHERE QuoteId IN (SELECT Id FROM Quotes WHERE TripId = @tripId)

restoreEvolviPricingExpires.description: Restore one Evolvi pricing's expiry by id
restoreEvolviPricingExpires.sql: UPDATE EvolviPricings SET Expires = @expires WHERE Id = @id

expireTripGroundServicePricings.description: Set the expiry of the active ground-service pricings of a trip to now + N minutes (quote status 14 excluded)
expireTripGroundServicePricings.sql: UPDATE [dbo].[GroundServicePricings] SET Expires = DATEADD(MINUTE, @minutes, GETDATE()) WHERE QuoteId IN (SELECT Id FROM Quotes WHERE TripId = @tripId AND Product = 'groundService' AND Status <> 14)
expireTripGroundServicePricings.snapshot: SELECT Id AS id, Expires AS expires FROM [dbo].[GroundServicePricings] WHERE QuoteId IN (SELECT Id FROM Quotes WHERE TripId = @tripId AND Product = 'groundService' AND Status <> 14)

restoreGroundServicePricingExpires.description: Restore one ground-service pricing's expiry by id

setTripCarPickupDate.description: Set the pickup date of the car segments of a trip
setTripCarPickupDate.sql: UPDATE CarSegments SET PickupDate = @pickupDate WHERE QuoteId IN (SELECT Id FROM Quotes WHERE Product = 'car' AND TripId = @tripId)
setTripCarPickupDate.snapshot: SELECT Id AS id, PickupDate AS pickupDate FROM CarSegments WHERE QuoteId IN (SELECT Id FROM Quotes WHERE Product = 'car' AND TripId = @tripId)

restoreCarSegmentPickupDate.description: Restore one car segment's pickup date by id
restoreCarSegmentPickupDate.sql: UPDATE CarSegments SET PickupDate = @pickupDate WHERE Id = @id

setTripHotelPrice.description: Force price, tax and total price of the hotel pricings of a trip
setTripHotelPrice.sql: UPDATE HotelPricings SET Price = @price, Tax = @tax, TotalPrice = @totalPrice WHERE QuoteId IN (SELECT Id FROM Quotes WHERE TripId = @tripId)
setTripHotelPrice.snapshot: SELECT Id AS id, Price AS price, Tax AS tax, TotalPrice AS totalPrice FROM HotelPricings WHERE QuoteId IN (SELECT Id FROM Quotes WHERE TripId = @tripId)

restoreHotelPricingPrice.description: Restore one hotel pricing's price, tax and total price by id
restoreHotelPricingPrice.sql: UPDATE HotelPricings SET Price = @price, Tax = @tax, TotalPrice = @totalPrice WHERE Id = @id
